title: 第175章 “换气。”
slug: 万一小叔对假千金是柏拉图呢
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

那件睡裙是祝砚铮给她买的。

或者说，其实宋瓷住进亭栖云邸之后，她的吃穿住行，大多时候都是由祝砚铮一手操办的。

他似乎乐于替她操办这些事，并把这些事当作是他生活的一部分。

所以那件睡裙，祝砚铮见过。

真丝的面料质感，穿在身上好像水流一般，如若无物。

他提起裙摆的一角，让她咬住。

便没了遮挡。

少女整个人被压在了门框上，冰凉的大门触感传遍全身，宋瓷身上激起一阵凉意。

嘴巴咬了衣料，少女的嗓音是从喉头间滚出来的。

听不清在说些什么。

男人西装革履。

上半身的衬衣以及西装马甲并未褪去，宽肩窄腰的身形，将他衬得更加高大。

他太高了，以至于轻易将她倾覆，将她整个人拢入骨血。

衣冠完整，甚至找不出半分纰漏。

与他不同，面前的少女只穿了一身睡裙，真丝的面料轻易被压出衣褶。

宋瓷微微挑眉，一双泪眼却好似受惊的幼鹿，转头看向男人。

神情不辨。

房间内那盏夜灯不够明亮，也只能勾勒出男人身形的轮廓与肌肉的线条。

轻轻启唇，少女嗓音轻软呜咽：“祝砚铮……”

她又这样叫他，好像什么隐秘的信号。

男人并未回她，只是拦着她小腹的手臂收了力道，像是要将她融入血肉一般。

少女刚洗过澡，身上带着清新的铃兰花香。

睡裙吊带一侧滑落肩头，露出少女漂亮白皙的肌肤。

那身睡裙宽松柔滑，轻易地遮掩住了什么。

微微蹙眉，宋瓷眼底闪过一瞬的疑惑。

没有如她所愿。

双手缓缓向下，并拢了她的腿心。

如果此时的宋瓷低头看去，甚至能看到略略狼狈的狰狞。

这是……什么意思？

宋瓷眉骨微微下压，心中却涌现出一丝不安。

他分明也在隐忍着，却不肯如她所愿，只是这般厮磨着她。

温凉的唇顺着她的脊骨，一路向下。

俯身吻过她的后腰，宋瓷下意识地弓背，却因此更明显地感知到了腰身下的。

祝、祝砚铮这么能忍吗？

宋瓷心中暗骂一句，眼底闪过一抹冷意。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Zhu Yanzheng bought that nightgown for her.

In other words, in fact, after Song Ci moved into Tingqiyun Mansion, most of her food, clothing, housing and transportation were all taken care of by Zhu Yanzheng.

He seemed happy to do these things for her and regarded them as part of his life.

So Zhu Yanzheng had seen that nightgown before.

The texture of the silk fabric makes it feel like water flowing on your body, as if it were nothing.

He lifted a corner of his skirt and let her bite it.

There is no cover.

The girl's whole body was pressed against the door frame, and the cold touch of the door spread throughout her body, arousing a chill in Song Ci's body.

Her mouth bit the fabric, and the girl's voice rolled out of her throat.

Can't hear clearly what is being said.

Men in suits and ties.

The shirt and suit vest on his upper body were still on, and his wide shoulders and narrow waist made him taller.

He was so tall that he easily overturned her and crushed her whole body into bones and blood.

The clothes are complete, not even a single flaw can be found.

Unlike him, the girl in front of him only wore a nightgown, and the silk fabric was easily pressed out of the folds.

Song Ci raised her eyebrows slightly, but her teary eyes looked like a frightened young deer as she turned to look at the man.

The expression is indistinguishable.

The night light in the room was not bright enough and could only outline the outline of the man's figure and the lines of his muscles.

She gently opened her lips, and the girl whimpered in a soft voice: "Zhu Yanzheng..."

She called him that again, as if it was some secret signal.

The man did not reply to her, but only tightened the strength of the arm holding her lower abdomen, as if he wanted to fuse her into flesh and blood.

The girl had just taken a bath, and her body was filled with the fresh fragrance of lily of the valley.

One side of the nightgown straps slipped off her shoulders, revealing the girl's beautiful fair skin.

The nightgown was loose and smooth, covering something easily.

Frowning slightly, Song Ci's eyes flashed with doubt for a moment.

Not as she wished.

His hands slowly moved down and closed the center of her legs.

If Song Ci looked down at this time, he could even see a slightly embarrassed look.

What does this mean?

Song Ci's eyebrows were slightly depressed, but there was a hint of uneasiness in her heart.

He was obviously holding back, but he refused to do what she wanted, and just rubbed her like this.

The warm lips followed her spine, all the way down.

Leaning over and kissing her lower back, Song Ci subconsciously arched her back, but because of this, she felt the pain under her waist more clearly.

Zhu, Zhu Yanzheng, can you be so patient?

Song Ci cursed secretly in his heart, and a coldness flashed in his eyes.
